verdict.rationale: Stripe provides full API coverage for cardholders, cards, spend controls, balances, and transactions, plus a dedicated 'Issuing for agents' doc describing task-scoped virtual cards, auto-invalidation, and ML risk scoring on authorizations — directly matching the agent-operated card program story. Stripe also documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, which would include Issuing endpoints for reading/creating/updating resources with scoped credentials.  Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on evidence confirming MCP-scoped credential restrictions specifically for Issuing endpoints, and no field report of an agent successfully operating a live card program end-to-end.
